findings.12333_missing_record: The sole missing pointer, target provision not located: EO:12333, corresponds to original section 3(a) excluding special activities as defined in that order. The original wording establishes its role as a scope exclusion; it neither amends EO:12333 nor incorporates an independent continuing command or cessation trigger. Resolving the excluded activity definition is unnecessary to determine termination of all EO:13283 commands. Missing definition source is retained as a disclosed nonmaterial limitation.
findings.counterevidence: Dossier conflicts and current-law leads are empty. Bounded OFR catalog/saved-order search supplies only an EO:12333 cross-reference and the EO:13385 revocation; its matching local candidate rows were read. Matching current-law fragment rows contain an OLRC revocation note using the actor signing date, resolved by actor section 10. Selected eCFR search has two machine hits but no substantive eCFR snippets in the supplied dossier or matching local fragment rows; no claim of having read those underlying hits is adopted. This limitation is nonmaterial for this historical termination because the original commands are Office-specific and the complete actor unconditionally revokes them. These are bounded searches, not proof of exhaustive non-EO coverage. USC currency ends October 9 and is not used for an October 14 current predicate.
findings.earliest_end: EO:13385 section 9 expressly revokes EO:13283; section 10 makes the whole actor effective September 30, 2005. The September 29 signing date and October 4 Federal Register publication date do not control. Original sections 1-7 supply no fixed sunset, report-completion cessation or earlier effective end. All three own-term leads were read: temporary communicator teams, personnel availability and appropriations/support qualifications govern performance, not expiration of the continuing Office scheme. No earlier amendment/end is identified in the held chain or catalog candidate records.
findings.inventory: The eleven corrected disjoint spans preserve sections 1,2,3(a-d),4,5,6,7(a-b). Section 3(c) retains the teams’ information duties and foreign-deployment consultation/notification proviso. Omitted material consists of nonoperative headings, page furniture, signature and filing matter. Sections 4 and 6 assistance duties and section 5 NSC coordination are Office-specific; section 7 limits powers/rights. No independent duty survives the unconditional revocation.
